intent: Nested hierarchy people open and close level by level to browse, pick, or check items.
useWhen: Teams, folders, or account trees the user walks level by level
Browse, pick one, or check several items in a nested data hierarchy
doNotUseWhen: Page sections that disclose copy — use Accordion or Collapsible
App navigation — use SideNav or AppNav
Flat comparable columns — use Table or DataTable
A short flat choice list — use Select or RadioGroup

items.note: A node with children (even []) is a folder. Omit children on a leaf.

selected.note: controlled node ids. Single keeps 0 or 1 id. Ignored when selection is none.

showIcons.note: Folder, FolderOpen, and File via LucideByName. Not Material Symbols.

requirements: Tree has an accessible name from label
Each node is role=treeitem with aria-level
Folders set aria-expanded; collapsed children are hidden from AT
selection=single uses aria-selected; selection=multiple sets aria-multiselectable and aria-checked (including mixed on branches)
Disabled nodes set aria-disabled and are not selectable
Keyboard: Up/Down move among visible nodes; Left/Right collapse, expand, or move to parent/child; Home/End; Space/Enter select or toggle

doNot: Do not use Accordion or Collapsible for a data hierarchy
Do not use SideNav or AppNav for a data tree
Do not use Table or DataTable for nested browse/pick
Do not use Select or RadioGroup for a nested tree
Do not invent a local nested list, folder row, or tree checkbox — compose kit Checkbox
Do not add Density or drag-and-drop
Do not use Material Symbols or raw hex
snippet: <TreeView label="Workspace" selection="multiple" defaultExpanded={['design']} items={[{ id: 'design', label: 'Design', children: [{ id: 'brand', label: 'Brand' }] }, { id: 'legal', label: 'Legal' }]} />
